messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I strained my lower back and the pain is intense. Can you see me today?

If this is an emergency, please hang up and call 119 for an ambulance right away. If it's not an emergency, I can tell you that we do treat back pain. We are open until seven this evening. Would you like to know how to book an appointment?
No, it's not bad enough for an ambulance.

I'm glad to hear that. You can book an appointment through the online reservation form on our website. If you'd prefer to arrange it by phone, I can have a staff member call you back. What would you like to do?
Got it, thank you very much.
